source.notes: Single color, clean paths, no filters/effects, viewBox optimized for 16x16 up to 512x512. Uses currentColor so CSS can recolor it for headers, dark cards, or admin menus.

usage_notes: Create the .wordpress-org/ folder at the repository root; it maps to the WordPress.org SVN assets folder.
Replace 'dashicons-chart-area' in add_menu_page() with DASHLYTICS_PLUGIN_URL . 'assets/images/dashlytics-icon.svg' to use the custom admin icon.
WordPress.org plugin icons MUST be PNG; SVG is only used inside the plugin itself.
Keep the master SVG single-color (currentColor) so it can be recolored via CSS.
Run 'bash build-plugin.sh' after adding assets/images/ files to ensure they are included in the distribution ZIP.
Do not rename image files after uploading to the WordPress media library.
